subject: Request: SDLC artifact pack — PR signoffs, pipeline attestations & transient KMS logs
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@northbridge.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: northbridge-audit@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC artifact pack — PR signoffs, pipeline attestations & transient KMS logs

Jasmine —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/SOC2 evidence collection for the Northbridge assessment we need a focused SDLC artifact pack covering the last 60 days. Can you provide the following where available?

- PR signoff register (per-PR approver + timestamp + linked commit) for the main repo and inference-runtime repo
- CI/CD pipeline attestation (list of pipeline runs + run IDs + artifacts produced) for the same period
- Change approval chronology for any deploys flagged as approved outside normal hours (hotfixes)
- Export of transient KMS activity showing ephemeral key rotations/usage for model-serving key aliases (we only need metadata: key alias, rotation timestamp, requester identity)

We understand some logs are ephemeral. If you prefer, a time-limited S3 link or a zipped bundle is fine. Deadline: can you share an initial bundle by COB Friday (2026-04-23)?

If there's any scope ambiguity or sensitive items that need redaction, flag it and we can coordinate offline.

Cheers,
Liam
Senior Assessor, Northbridge Security

Attachments: none
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@northbridge.com>
Cc: northbridge-audit@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifact pack — PR signoffs, pipeline attestations & transient KMS logs

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a scoped bundle by COB Friday (2026-04-23). A few clarifying points so we scope correctly:

1) "Main repo and inference-runtime repo" — we have two monorepo components: `platform-api` (main) and `inference-runtime`. I will include both unless you want to restrict to one.
2) KMS exports — raw CloudKMS logs contain call payloads; we will export the minimal metadata you requested and put them in an encrypted S3 archive with a 72-hour presigned link.
3) Hotfix/change approvals — we will include the approval chronology and link to PRs and the on-call approval ticket where applicable.

Planned deliverables (initial):
- pr-signoff-manifest.csv (PR id, commit SHA, approver, timestamp, repo)
- ci-pipeline-attestation-2026-04.pdf (signed statement + CI run index)
- kms-rotation-export-2026-03_2026-04.jsonl (metadata only)
- change-approval-chronology.md (brief timeline + links)
- sdlc-evidence-bundle-2026-04-23.zip (encrypted, will provide link)

I'll loop in engineering owners and security for export and redaction checks. Let me know if you prefer a different format (CSV vs spreadsheet) for the manifest.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Security & Trust Programs — Redwood Inference

Attachment plan: we will attach the manifest and a preliminary attestation PDF to the bundle.
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SDLC artifact pack — action: gather artifacts (PR signoffs, CI runs, KMS export)

Team —

Forwarding Northbridge's request below. Target: assemble the deliverables listed and hand to me for packaging by Friday COB. Quick tasking:

- Karthik: export transient KMS metadata for alias `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/serving/cryptoKeys/model-serving-*` covering 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-20. Provide as newline JSONL with fields: alias, rotation_ts, requester (service account or user). Mark any records that include requestor emails that are third-party.
- Irene: generate PR signoff manifest for `platform-api` and `inference-runtime`. Include PR id, head commit SHA, list of approvers, timestamp, and link to PR. CSV preferred.
- Jordan: pull CI run index and attestation for the 60-day window from our build meta-store (run id, pipeline name, status, artifacts produced). If there are any runs with "manual approval" flagged, include the approval ticket link.

Notes: If any export hits retention/permission barriers, tell me immediately so we can request the right level of access. This will be delivered to an external auditor; redact any IAM tokens or ephemeral secrets if they appear in logs.

Thanks —
Jasmine

Jasmine / Irene / Jordan —

Short update on artifacts I am preparing:

1) KMS metadata export (metadata-only, no payloads): kms-rotation-export-2026-03_2026-04.jsonl — contains alias, rotation_ts (ISO8601), requester_identity (service account or user principal). Approx 120 lines.

2) PR signoff manifest (Irene and I combined notes): pr-signoff-manifest.csv — columns: repo, pr_id, head_sha, approvers(semi-colon), first_approval_ts, merge_ts, approval_type(manual/auto). We sampled and removed reviewer email addresses for internal privacy; approver identity uses short username.

3) CI pipeline attestation: ci-pipeline-attestation-2026-04.pdf — brief attestation signed by Platform Eng Lead stating pipeline fidelity, plus a CSV index (ci-run-index-2026-03_to_2026-04.csv) listing run_id, pipeline, status, artifact_keys.

4) Change approvals: change-approval-chronology.md — enumerates 3 hotfix deploys during the window with ticket links (JIRA: RI-2345, RI-2378, RI-2410) and the recorded approvers.

Attachment stubs included for packaging: pr-signoff-manifest.csv (2.4 MB), ci-run-index-2026-03_to_2026-04.csv (1.2 MB), ci-pipeline-attestation-2026-04.pdf (45 KB), kms-rotation-export-2026-03_2026-04.jsonl (320 KB), change-approval-chronology.md (12 KB).

Notes/risks:
- KMS export is metadata-only but references service account identities; per policy we can redact full principal emails and replace with short service-account names (we did that).
- One PR included a third-party contributor email; we redacted the full email and noted it in the manifest.
- If the auditor needs raw logs (CloudKMS audit entries) we need an elevated export request — advise if necessary.

I'll stage everything to an encrypted S3 bucket and send you the presigned link once Irene and Jordan confirm the package.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Platform Engineer
